name: subgrade irregularity
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 路基几何状态的空间不规则变化。
usage_overview: 在车辆—轨道相互作用分析中，作为路基表面的初始变形轮廓，用于考察几何偏差造成的轨道支承变化及其附加激励作用。

complete_examples.text: The subgrade irregularity can be obtained by the iterative proposed in Ref. [37].
The center of subgrade irregularity region is located at 40 m in the longi tudinal direction.
